description:
Identify and export the countries that share a land border with Germany.

1. In the loaded 'countries_base' project, select 'Germany' in the 'ne_110m_admin_0_countries' layer.
2. Use a spatial selection tool (e.g., Select by Layer / Location) to select all countries that touch or intersect the selected Germany feature.
3. Ensure that Germany itself is NOT included in the final selection (remove it if necessary).
4. Export the selected neighboring countries to a new shapefile at: `/home/ga/gvsig_data/exports/germany_neighbors.shp`.

The output file must contain only the countries bordering Germany (e.g., France, Poland, Austria, etc.).
